messages.author: Folake Adeyemi
messages.text: Whole weeks from the committed date to the certificate date, capped by the agreement — not the customer's stabilisation date.

messages.author: Mats Lindgren
messages.text: Their five-week number is above the cap and above Folake's limit. If anyone wants to pay it, it comes to me and it is not pre-approved.

messages.author: Desmond Quayle
messages.text: Offering support days instead of the damages is a contract exception and mine to grant; nobody has asked.
